name: Why is surface preparation so important for painting projects?

mainEntity.name: Why is surface preparation so important for painting projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective surface preparation is crucial because it directly impacts the longevity, appearance, and adhesion of the paint. Without it, new paint may not bond properly, leading to premature peeling, cracking, or bubbling. It also ensures a smooth, uniform surface for the paint to adhere to, preventing imperfections from showing through the final coats. Investing time in preparation saves significant time and cost on future repairs or repainting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper surface preparation is vital for paint longevity, appearance, and adhesion, preventing issues like peeling and ensuring a smooth, durable finish.
